The user wants to remove timer.exe they had previously scheduled via Task Scheduler? They mention "using the taskkill command". Actually they want to kill it and maybe delete file.

We need to use tool to run OS command. We should ask clarifying question about location path etc. But we could assume typical scenario: timer.exe located somewhere like C:\Windows\System32\timer.exe or custom path. Use taskkill /IM timer.exe /F then del timer.exe if needed.
